name: Fubuki Clockford
original_name: フブキ＝クロックフォード
source:
One of the Master Detectives dispatched to Kanai Ward. Her Forte is Time Leap.

Because of her upbringing as a lady of the world-famous Clockford Family, she is a bit naive. She has a uniquely peculiar way of thinking, which can frustrate and confuse the people she talks to.

[From [url=https://www.spike-chunsoft.co.jp/raincode/en/character/]official website[/url]]
